info.title: Umago API
info.description: Self-hosted, cookieless web analytics. Public ingest endpoints need no auth and always answer 202. Admin endpoints need the session cookie (POST /api/v1/auth/login), HTTP Basic, or a bearer API key (umago_key_…). MCP tokens (umago_tok_…) and UMAGO_MCP_TOKEN are read-only: GET only. Public share links grant read-only access to one site's GET endpoints via ?share=<slug>. Errors are {error, message}.
